translation_notes: only URIRef("http://test/p") -> <http://test/p> is rewritten; everything else in the triple has to stay Python

NEGATIVE FINDING: the mechanical draft turned g.add((...)) into 'g += g{ {BNode(bname)} <http://test/p> "value" }', which is NOT equivalent here. g is an rdflib Dataset: Dataset.add() puts the triple in the default graph (urn:x-rdflib:default) while Graph.__iadd__ calls addN with the Dataset itself as context, which lands the quad in a fresh anonymous named graph. The g{...} idiom is therefore unusable for Dataset targets, and the island can only supply individual terms

BNode(bname) cannot become an island either: the label is computed at runtime ('N' + 'a' * 32) and ldpy's _:label is lexical and island-scoped, while _:{expr} is a data-keyed bnode with different identity semantics -- and both only exist inside g{}
Literal("value") stays Literal(...): outside an island a bare "value" is a Python str, and "value"^^xsd:string would be a different rdflib term
